member.name: T:RtfBridge.SystemDrawing.SystemDrawingImageRenderer
member.summary: Rasterizes WMF/EMF picture payloads to PNG via (GDI+). Windows-only. On non-Windows hosts returns null so the core library falls back to its inline placeholder + warning.

member.name: P:RtfBridge.SystemDrawing.SystemDrawingImageRenderer.TargetDpi
member.summary: Target DPI used when rasterizing. Defaults to 96.

member.name: P:RtfBridge.SystemDrawing.SystemDrawingImageRenderer.MaxOutputDimensionPx
member.summary: Optional cap on output pixel dimensions. Metafiles that would exceed this are downscaled.
